question: Estimate the total domestic tourism trips during summer vacation season (May-June).
idealClarificationQuestions: Domestic leisure tourism trips (overnight stay; not daily commute)? Yes.
Includes hill stations, family travel, religious tourism? All.
Per-person trips (each individual counted as 1 trip)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual domestic tourist visits in India: ~250 crore (Ministry of Tourism — counts each visit; one person can take multiple).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, May-June peak summer season: ~20% = ~50 crore visits.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, leisure/holiday travel (excluding business + religious commute): ~50% = 25 crore leisure visits.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~25-30 crore domestic summer leisure tourism trips.
